text:
jordan_sales: Hey team — Montara Bank just sent back the SIG and wants question-by-question evidence. I started filling the spreadsheet but need quick artifacts for Q12 (KMS), Q27 (audit logs), Q41 (pen test), Q58 (data residency). Can @priya_k or @alex_w pick up KMS + logs?
priya_k: on it. can you paste the spreadsheet link?
jordan_sales: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/ONBOARD-MONTARA/SIG-answers (sheet tab: MONTARA_SIG_2026) — I filled high-level answers but they want attachments/proofs.
alex_w: tagging engsec for pen test evidence. @engsec-bot can you attach latest pentest report & SOC2 cert? :pray: 
engsec-bot: Uploading artifacts now: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/2026-03/pentest-report.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/2026-03/soc2-type2.pdf
leah_ops: For Q27 (audit logs) — retention policy and example query. We keep logs 365 days for prod. Add these artifacts: confluence link + sample query.
leah_ops: Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/LOGS+Retention+and+Access
leah_ops: Sample CloudWatch query (paste into CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter service = \"inference-runtime\" and level = \"ERROR\"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
```
priya_k: KMS details for Q12 — we use customer-managed keys for Dedicated & Private. For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with CMKs in our KMS. Evidence: key policy doc + audit ARN. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/KMS+Usage and S3 artifacts: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/kms-policy.json
priya_k: Quick snippet of the key lifecycle policy (paste into spreadsheet as evidence note):
```
KeyRotation: Enabled
RotationPeriodDays: 365
AccessPrincipals: [redwood-kms-role, montara-dedicated-role]
```
maria_g: Q41 (pen test) — redacted summary is ok for initial review. Full report requires NDA; sales already sent NDA to Montara legal? @jordan_sales
jordan_sales: NDA sent yesterday. Montara legal called for clarifying scope, but they said summary is fine to proceed.
alex_w: Q58 (data residency) — Montara asked about EU residency for backups. For Dedicated we can pin region eu-west-1 and store backups in customer VPC or specific S3 bucket with region lock. Evidence: architecture diagram and backup policy. Arch diagram: https://redwood.app/diagrams/montara-backup-2026.png and backup policy doc s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/backup-policy.md
leah_ops: Also add support ticket link showing proof of region pin for previous customer (anonymized): https://support.redwood.ai/cases/CASE-2025-9981 (redacted)
priya_k: I'll upload the KMS policy and a short README with steps to generate the audit extract. Giving CLI snippet to pull last 90 days of key usage from CloudTrail:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-31 --query 'Events[] | [?contains(Resources[].ResourceName, `kms`)]' > montara_kms_events.json
```
jordan_sales: Perfect — can we get all artifacts into the Montara folder and then I'll attach to the SIG sheet? Please put filenames with prefix MONTARA_SIG_ so it's obvious.
engsec-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/MONTARA_SIG_pentest-redacted.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/MONTARA_SIG_kms-policy.json, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/montara/MONTARA_SIG_audit-retention.md
maria_g: I'll craft the Q41 answer copy: "Redwood provides a third-party penetration test performed annually; redacted summary attached. Full report available under NDA."
priya_k: I added a short answer for Q12: "Customer-managed CMKs supported for Dedicated and Private; hosted uses envelope encryption. KMS rotation and access policy attached (MONTARA_SIG_kms-policy.json)."
leah_ops: I updated Q27 with retention statement and sample query plus link to logs policy doc.
jordan_sales: Amazing. Final ask — can someone sanity-check Q34 (third-party subprocessors) and Q49 (incident response SLA)? I drafted quick lines but want accuracy.
alex_w: For Q34 list: AWS, Fastly (CDN), Datadog. I'll add their roles and subprocessors table.
maria_g: For Q49 incident response: standard escalation timeline is 15 min for sev1 by oncall, 1 hour initial response for non-prod sev1s. We have SLA doc link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SUPPORT/pages/Incident+Response+SLA and I'll attach MONTARA_SIG_incident-sla.pdf.
jordan_sales: OK I'll finish the sheet and send back to Montara by EOD PST. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
leah_ops: leaving notes in the sheet for which artifacts are redacted vs shareable.
engsec-bot: Reminder: mark any artifact needing NDA with tag [NDA_REQUIRED] in the sheet.
priya_k: I'll follow up with Montara SE if they want a short walkthrough for KMS + logging evidence.
maria_g: good call. ping me if they ask for more redactions.
jordan_sales: closing loop — will post final thread once Montara confirms receipt.
